artifacts.reviewState: Peer review pending; static reference is not runtime evidence

browserInspection.reason: CUA refused local file:// URL; allowed protocols http/https only, with explicit no workaround instruction. No alternate surface/server opened.
browserInspection.method: File/content checks only; screenshots and responsive rendered acceptance remain independent review work.
browserInspection.rejection: Browser Use rejected this action due to browser security policy. Reason: The browser URL policy blocks this action. Browser use cannot visit the requested page. The requested URL protocol is not allowed. Allowed protocols: "http:", "https:". The agent must not attempt to achieve the same outcome via workaround, indirect execution, raw CDP or browser commands, alternate browser surfaces, or policy circumvention. Proceed only with a materially safer alternative that does not require this blocked browser action; if none exists, stop and request user input.

direction.description: Neutral graphite author workbench and a light reading context. Mathematical viewport is quiet graphite with semantic colored geometry, modest Cartesian grid and opaque labels. Warmth comes from comfortable spacing, helpful copy and predictable controls.
distinguishingChoices: Broad undistracted scene area with math strip immediately below, not a decorative dashboard.
Author panes share flat surfaces/dividers; controls have modest 5px radii while workspace corners remain nearly square.
Readable labels carry names and values; icons are short navigation aids, never sole instruction.
Reader controls align with the demonstrated formula, while author tools remain available in named panels.
direction.alignment: Pane titles, fields, lists and prose left aligned; numbers right aligned; mathematical display centered within its own stable box.

fonts.math: Cambria Math, STIX Two Math, serif
fonts.rationale: Local Windows workbench familiarity and Cyrillic support; readable UI and distinct mathematical letterforms without font downloads.
fonts.numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; reserve signed numeric width with units in separate fixed slots

color.semanticRule: Keep a/b/angle/result colors stable across scene, fields, formula and graph. Text labels, shape and stroke patterns also communicate role. Neutral chrome accent is not a fifth mathematical value.
color.contrastRule: Validate actual text pairs >=4.5:1 for ordinary text; control boundaries/focus/essential geometry >=3:1 against adjacent surface. Subtle grid is auxiliary; never use its color for essential data.
color.borderUsage: Subtle #454F5D is reserved for pane/layout dividers; ordinary input/button/navigation/readonly boundaries use #A6B8D0.

tokens.density: Compact desktop by user authority:11px UI with24–26px rows/controls,8px groups and8px pane padding. any-pointer:coarse or viewport<=720 restores44px targets; field outer46px includes borders around44px input. Larger textbook prose/formulas and CSS-pixel geometry labels remain separate. Compactness never relies on font/geometry scaling.

composition: Scene title + one sentence of aim
Viewport with camera/fit controls and explicitly available expand action
Formula and exact input fields a/b/theta; derived c_squared read-only
Current step caption + previous/play/next + scrub; chapter entry through named menu
Return to guide appears when overrides exist; reset view and reset values separate
embedded.size: Geometry retains aspect-reserved scene size. Compact header/inputs/transport and content-sized formula; under720px/coarse touch commands44px and fields46px outer/44px input. Formula grows only for genuine wraps; no92/86px blank-height gate.
embedded.controls: Show only document-permitted learner edits. Author create/import/export/keyframe tools are not learner controls. All permitted views/actions remain reachable through labelled expansion or view menu.
embedded.focus: Initial load never steals lesson focus; expand retains semantic focus and state. Close expanded view restores originating control.
embedded.text: Keep c²=13 and full relation visible; controls do not cover geometry. Teach the meaning of theta before assuming notation fluency.

composition: Topbar with lesson title, current chapter, view/layout controls, return to lesson
Left pane: lesson objects and guide chapters; graph is read-only
Center: scene; optional synchronized second view or table/plot
Right: permitted typed parameters, derived results and provenance
Bottom: step transport and captions; Graph/Table/Code/Terms tabs for linked inspection
learnerLab.default: Scene + allowed inputs + current formula/caption are visible first. Additional views open through explicit tabs. Lab panel layouts persist as view preferences, not document history.
learnerLab.capabilities: Read-only computation/term graphs, tables, tensor memory/trace, plots, UV/image channels, A/B, seed/replay controls and state links appear when relevant to the document. Editing operators/keyframes/permissions remains an author capability.
learnerLab.phone: Single active scene/data view with labelled view switcher; parameters and guide use stacked disclosure sections. All panels remain reachable; no tiny desktop docking squeezed into a phone.

author.composition: 36px compact project/workspace toolbar; left scene/project tree; center reserved viewport toolbar + geometry + content-sized formula strip; right tabbed inspector; bottom Timeline/Curves/Graph/Guidance panels.
topbar: Workspace presets: Scene, Animate, Compute, Guide
Learner preview with explicit preview role and edit-return action
Validated export/embed action with dependency/permission diagnostics

organization.sceneTree: Search, add palette, hierarchy rows; selected name always readable. Visibility/lock/isolate on hover or selected row, keyboard actions exposed in context menu. Multi-selection count and mixed inspector values explicit.
organization.projectTree: Named Objects/Assets/Compositions tabs; assets show dependencies, loading/cancel/retry and missing resources; imported GLB/ABC/USD display format capability diagnostics.
organization.inspector: Object/Parameters/Bindings/Learner tabs. Common fields first; disclosure groups for transforms, pivot/parenting, units/axes, materials/lights/textures/custom WGSL, constraints, image channels, quality. Property search finds collapsed fields. Scalar/int/bool/vector/matrix/enum/color/file controls generated from schema. Reference selected identity is triangle; heading, tree selection and hint agree. Fields a/b/theta explicitly affect that triangle; curve track context states Triangle / theta. Desktop common fields26px row/24px envelope, first group avoids duplicate top margin; explanations stay present with4px helper margin.
organization.timeline: Persistent transport; chapter/marker lane then object track tree with numeric/current value column; key/clip lanes, group/NLA/additive layer controls, snap, work range, zoom navigator. Clear logical time unit displayed; audio/captions lanes named. Current selected track stays synchronized with curves and inspector. Track list reserves same22px ruler row as lanes; shared24px row heights, identical6px vertical padding, playhead anchored after ruler. Key20px chapter plate sits centered in24px desktop lane;10px key diamond retains stroke clearance. Coarse/mobile lane44px.
organization.curveEditor: Track list + graph, mode switch Value/Speed, interpolation selector and tangent buttons. Keys and handles have distinct shapes; selected keys get outline. Hold/linear/Bezier/auto/continuous and retiming/camera paths supported through inspector and context menu. Only runtime-authoritative sampled curves carry mathematical value labels; schematic reference has no time/value data.
organization.computationGraph: Graph toolbar includes search/add/fit and diagnostic filter; nodes show operation name, typed input/output ports and shape/unit/provenance. Edges follow actual evaluated graph IDs. Select node => operands/results and source location in inspector. Connection validation previews error before commit; invalid cycle/unit/shape connection does not create a partial graph.
organization.guidance: Chapters, pause gates, hotspots, branch/state-machine editor, captions, quizzes/challenges and optional audio available as author panels. Preview shows exactly permitted learner controls and reset policy.
organization.history: Named transaction list separate from session event log/replay and workspace history. Camera/hover/selection are view state. Recovery/conflict states describe which file/tab owns unsaved data.
organization.export: Portable archive + PNG/SVG/frame/video destinations; format/capability matrix, assets/license manifest, explicit codec support and deterministic time range. Disabled format explains reason; no false completion status.

author.resizing: Desktop pane limits: tree 180..320px, inspector 248..400px; central view >=380px. Splitters keyboard resize with 8px hit region; 1px divider. Presets restore a usable layout. Float means in-app pane, not OS window.
author.constrainedWidth: Under 1100px tree can become a named Objects drawer; under 820px one main editor + inspector toggle + bottom section. Native/full-window continues to offer all editors; 320px fallback stacks labelled sections and viewport. Workspace collapse is user visible and reversible, not feature removal. Static graph specimen switches to readable vertical nodes on phones; curve specimen retains natural width in a named keyboard-scrollable region. At <=980px labelled 'Открыть объекты' native disclosure shows full tree in reference. It changes reference visibility only; runtime drawer implementation remains unproven. Drawer open state includes identical triangle selection and keyboard/focus-return guidance. Compact Objects disclosure also restores Library/Resources/Compositions/Add. Figure layout switches to narrow at actual container<=500px, independent of viewport/media; desktop narrow still11px labels. Scene canvas has explicit layer0, labels1/handles2; reserved viewport toolbar is34px above figure, controls3/corner4.

control.normal: Solid input surface and discernible 1px border; persistent label above/beside; units outside editable text. Boundary #A6B8D0 is separate from subtle pane divider.
control.hover: Raised fill or lighter border, no scale/position change.
control.pressed: Background #263344 with #A6B8D0 boundary; stable size and 11px label. Static pressed specimen is not an active command.
control.selected: Selection fill + 2px semantic indicator + aria-pressed/selected as applicable; color alone insufficient.
control.focus: 2px light blue outline with 2px offset or inset at clipped edges, visible against both surfaces; never hidden under sticky chrome.
control.disabled: Dim foreground while retaining label; explicit nearby reason or accessible description; not shown as an active command.
control.readonly: Non-editable value with result label and read-only semantics; not styled as disabled unreadable text.
control.locked: Lock icon + text/description; unlock is a separate permission-checked action.
control.mixed: Em dash and 'Mixed values' accessible text; editing deliberately applies one validated multi-edit transaction.
control.invalid: Error icon + border + inline message stating rejected value/constraint and valid next step; keep typed value for correction, truth unchanged.
control.loading: Reserved area with concise stage/progress and Cancel when possible. No endless spinner after a failed request.
control.stale: Explicit state when dependency/file changed; stale async results never silently replace active document.
control.empty: One concrete create/open/import action, not fabricated sample data.

states.semanticFocus: Selection persists; hover uses a lighter outline; guide focus uses dashed bracket/caption. Pointer exit restores guide while leaving selection. Propagate stable semantic IDs across all views.
states.status: Model failures are inline at source and in a focusable diagnostic list. No success toast or saved indicator until operation has confirmed completion.
states.numberField: Drag/scrub, Enter exact editing, commit/rollback, arrow nudge and visible unit. Show authored/base vs live override in inspector; Return to guide removes override. Reset values writes permitted current defaults as overrides with pause; Reset view only changes camera.
states.animationKey: Diamond for keyframe, small square for hold, tangent handles circles; interpolation name visible. Key at current time uses filled diamond, not ambiguous colored dot.

interaction.keyboard: Tab moves between control groups, arrow navigation within tree/tabs/graph/timeline, Enter selects/edits, Space activates focused transport, Escape cancels current interaction before closing a panel. Scope shortcuts to focused workspace; editable text keeps native keys/IME. All dragging has exact-field or menu alternatives; remappable keymap lists conflicts.
interaction.pointer: Pointer capture on actual drag handle. Direct drag/scrub updates truth/presentation without easing lag. One pointer gesture creates one undoable transaction. Esc/pointercancel returns checkpoint and never triggers a click.
interaction.touch: 44px targets; viewport handle radius >=22 CSS px. Vertical page scroll preserved away from handles; viewport gesture handling starts only on hit and indicates captured gesture. Numeric edit opens exact-value sheet; drag also has nudge controls. No hover-only command.
interaction.camera: Fit all/selected, ortho/perspective and view presets are labelled; page wheel scroll remains available; modified zoom and explicit zoom controls coexist. Navigation hints shown on focus/context request, not permanently as HUD.
interaction.docking: Craft docking move/split/float validated through application dispatch; drop target visible and keyboard layout actions available. Layout restoration does not replay mathematical edits.
interaction.undo: History transaction labels explain what changed; failed validation adds neither partial state nor false history entry.
interaction.accessibility: DOM equivalent for canvas objects/value summaries and graph/table data, accessible name/descriptions for every action. egui author path requires measured AccessKit focus/IME/clipboard/screen-reader result before shell acceptance. Meaningful caption does not rely on canvas pixels alone.
interaction.localization: Formal Russian imperatives, units outside fields, stable untranslated IDs; accommodate long EN/RU labels and locale number formatting without changing mathematical values. Browser zoom allowed.

motion.aim: Smooth response communicates relationships rather than decoration.
motion.direct: Drag, continuous scrub and captured camera gestures follow input exactly; no spring between pointer and picked handle. Input interrupts any existing transition immediately.
motion.discrete: Keyboard/typed commits may ease presentation with critically damped spring; settle exactly on current truth. Motion never recomputes or alters truth, seed or logical time.
motion.guides: Playback only after user action. Step/back/scrub/seek produce deterministic authority state; captions and graph focus synchronized to logical time, not decorative wall-clock fades.
motion.timingNote: Design targets, not measurements; runtime evidence must establish practical latency/frame stability. Transitions explicit transform/opacity, no transition:all.
motion.labels: Screen-pixel font and handle sizes independent of zoom. Stable anchoring with collision avoidance and hysteresis; numbers use fixed-width boxes. Move labels only when necessary, never through the figure; expose values in inspector if no collision-free position. Small displays preserve meaning.
motion.reducedMotion: Remove panel/camera easing and continuous decorative animation; step/cut presentation preserves all same values, controls, steps and geometry. No teaching content omitted.
motion.truthVsShown: Authoritative table/formula values always describe current truth. If discrete geometry is still settling, show unobtrusive transitional state or keep geometry-linked value presentation synchronized; never imply false measured agreement.

geometry.strokes: Essential SVG paths use vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke; side width2.5 CSS px, angle arc2 CSS px. DOM vertex handles14 CSS px diameter and2px outline, independent of geometry scale. Auxiliary grid remains quiet.
geometry.fills: Matte surfaces, low-opacity semantic region fills only when pedagogically meaningful. No specular UI/glass effects. Materials/lights remain full author capabilities.
geometry.labels: Desktop ordinary scene values/names are 11 CSS px by latest user choice; principal touch values16 CSS px, vertex/axis names11 CSS px. Separate absolutely-positioned DOM labels inside aspect-ratio figure; labels never inherit SVG scale. Fixed backing boxes reserve width: desktop a/b50,c64,angle42px; touch a/b64,c80,angle54px. Label positions switch explicitly at <=720px. Backing-to-side checks include1.25px half-stroke, not only label-pair rectangles; wide c anchor65%, narrow c82%. Container width<=500px uses narrow geometry.
geometry.framing: Fit includes semantic geometry/labels without clipping; axes/gizmo/panel areas reserved; inspector outside scene in default layouts. Expose explicit viewport tabs for local/world/view, clipping, A/B and synchronized views. Static reference reserves viewport toolbar above geometry; controls/corner have explicit z3/4, figurez0, DOM labelsz1 and handlesz2.
geometry.singular: Undefined/singular input/result shows reason and affected operation; draw only valid components, never invented zeros.
geometry.quality: Explicit quality preset/capability diagnostics affect AA/resolution/render cost; do not automatically remove labels, formula, controls or mathematical objects.
geometry.referenceFraming: Wide SVG760x420 maps O(180,306),A(300,98.15390309173472),B(500,306),scale80. Narrow SVG320x300 maps O(62,225),A(144.5,82.10580837556762),B(282,225),scale55. Separate DOM label/handle percent anchors share the exact SVG aspect ratio; no min-height letterbox changes their coordinate system. Narrow figure max-width480px. Both diagrams are static constants, not another evaluator. Graph node text is HTML/CSS11px, not SVG-scaled; narrow graph rearranges vertically. Curve SVG remains660x190 CSS px in a named scroll region so its11-unit labels are11px. Narrow value a anchors at14%, result c at82%, and axis x at95.5% to keep positive backing/name-box edge reserve in the320px embedded source model.

coverage.ui: No separate foundation dashboard; stable semantic IDs and authority/provenance support all fields/history.
Readable viewport, inputs, focus, camera, docking, menus, accessibility and responsive presets.
Asset/dependency panes, progress/cancel/retry; GLB/ABC/USD semantics and format capability diagnostics.
Save/open/version/recovery/conflict and portable/export/audio/caption workflows with honest completion states.
Distinct author/learner roles and artifacts; embedded/full-window continuity; isolated EN/RU cosine trial.
All canonical scenes and 98 course entry mapping preserve visual rules; independent full acceptance remains required.

craftUiAdapter.theme: WidgetPalette.apply_to handles five egui background states only. Install app-owned fonts, spacing, surfaces, selection and focus separately. noninteractive is not a disabled palette.
craftUiAdapter.buttons: IconButton::new(label,size,style).selected(...).show(...) supplies accessible label/response; app owns command dispatch and selection. Populate normal/hovered/pressed/selected + nonzero focus_stroke; use stable push_id.
craftUiAdapter.docking: Layout/Node/Action + DockArea/DockContent/DockStyle/PanelLimits; application validates/actions with permissions. Persist layout as view preferences; do not conflate with document Undo.
craftUiAdapter.toolbar: fit_toolbar preserves ordered groups and returns overflow indices; app must expose every index through full-size labelled overflow menu, or wrapping/scrollable fallback when fit returns None.
craftUiAdapter.caution: Donor inspected read-only; these APIs do not establish complete author product, application command history or browser accessibility. No donor source edits.

requested: Inspect author/learner/embedded composition and readability at 1440,1024,720,390,320 CSS px.
Compare fixture side lengths/angle/formula/result, including static SVG triangle geometry.
Check state specimens, keyboard/touch alternatives and motion/override semantics against runtime contracts.
Identify unexposed full features, role confusion, unreadable/overflowing labels or false runtime claims.
Then require real implemented runtime screenshots + measured motion/focus/IME/clipboard/accessibility and payload evidence before acceptance.
unresolved: Final DOM versus egui author shell decision remains measured gate.
Static reference cannot demonstrate input latency, animation/picking/math/runtime correctness or complete task acceptance.
No fixture-based authored animation curve available; curve illustration is explicitly schematic with no time/value numbers.
peerReview.sourceChecksOnly: Density iteration2 and historical fix1 F1/F2/F3 source corrections await independent re-review. Browser/rendered/mobile/screenshots/interactions remain NOT_RUN. User manual screenshot was inspected for spacing feedback; it is not our runtime/render acceptance.
